notes.title: Patch-notes Early Access version 1.1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/ef6b724b295600eb81d4fe1ae1cefbe266a81990.png

New Features


Portuguese and Spanish languages added!

Adding to English, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Russian versions, Minimal Move is now playable in Portuguese and Spanish!

You can now change the language directly in the game.


More puzzles to play!

We added 12 new levels! Woo-hoo!


New cinematics and story added! 

Let’s discover the story of Minimal Move with fun cinematics! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/c80132366d90a384f299804b39e6b70b64ca8087.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/d6f9554c8fa411c55501a025d7033c6e64fb5fe2.jpg


Skin customization system for the characters added! 

Enjoy choosing your favorite skins for the characters! Now you can unlock the skins by using the stars that you collected in the levels! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/636bf9f958c529eb4263ed87d827aff643037611.jpg


Fixed Bug


 We fixed un issue with the sound. 



 Minor fix on the HUD.

notes.title: Minimal Move received the Best Design Award at Taipei Game Show 2020!!!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce today that Minimal Move received the Best Design Award at Taipei Game Show 2020! 


We are so excited to receive such an honorable award from them! 


Thank you so much!!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/320af55b41d55d8cf8b65392c967f8aefed97e7e.jpg



It was such a big disappointment to not be able to attend the Taipei Game Show this year, however, they kept holding the Indie Game Award ceremony online, and we were selected for this! 


 

You can check their Online Ceremony from here! 


[previewyoutube=X0r61YmYP2o;full][/previewyoutube]
Check out our acceptance speech at the online ceremony!  



We wish we could be there at the ceremony offline! Next year, we hope to attend the Taipei Game Show and show Minimal Move!


 

Minimal Move is not yet finished. But this award encourages us to move forward for sure! 


 

Thank you Taiwan! Thank you Taipei Game Show! 

See you soon!!!

notes.title: How to play minimal move online co-op on steam
notes.content:
Minimal Move is  playable solo or co-op in local for now, but with Steam's Remote Play, now you can play Minimal Move with your friends on online! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/4be4fc21b5ca3a21e8929ccaf420edd60df3c82b.jpg

Maybe it's familiar already  if you are using Remote Play on Steam, but for those who is new to  Remote Play, we explain today how to play Minimal Move on Steam with the online co-op mode!

1 . Log into Steam and launch Minimal Move! 

You'll see this icon "Remote Play Together" on your screen (bottom right)! 

(You can't click this icon though...)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/7fa1d1627c16482e270b5457b102262c4e7ed68e.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/482502acdad0b6aada5a7b79d2b782e22e306247.jpg

2. Go to your friends list and invite your friend! 

Go to your friend list and right-click it on your friend's name. Now  choose "Remote Play Together"!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/7e6ab7b6d97f5c174fbbedc7c8a8df4df7e1a273.jpg

3. Your friend will recieve your invitation♡ 

Say YES! He/she can click "Play the game" (green) button! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/84c1a4edc5810585a7f69712bc2996625ce31c53.jpg

4. Go back to Minimal Move! 

Now you go back to play Minimal Move! You'll see this icon on your screen (bottom right)!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/c669cb86c64253ca384ed06632deb727281700a1.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/15719cb1133193e7db94c4cd3c51eb337c428eef.jpg

5. Enjoy Minimal Move! 

Choose CO-OP mode on the menu. 

You (person who invite) is going to be a player #1. 

Your friend (person who got invited) is a player #2. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/9ad038b02bd631f88a409abb8c4e15f8ef139119.jpg

Have fun!!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/973d2c629d112dcc962099a88e525bbdfb2c58ba.jpg

We hope it's easy to understand how to play this game online co-op mode using Remote Play on steam! 


Steam also explain with a video here: https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay


If you have any question regarding to Minimal Move, please feel free to contact us! 


Discord: https://discord.com/invite/G4ajCtD

Twitter: https://twitter.com/MinimalMoveGame

Instagram:  https://www.instagram.com/minimalmovegame/ 

Facebook:  https://www.facebook.com/MinimalMoveGame/

Minimal Move Early Access is now available on Steam!

Thank you for supporting us!


日本語でのRemote Playの説明はこちらからどうぞ！：https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay?l=japanese


ぜひお友達とオンラインで遊んでみてください！

＊オンラインコープモードは現在の段階でSteamのみになります。

[previewyoutube=h7cPIibnmpA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Minimal Move Early Access is available on Steam today!
notes.content:
Today is the day!  
Minimal Move launches into early access on Steam starting from today!


[previewyoutube=h7cPIibnmpA;full][/previewyoutube]


The current Early Access version will offer the first 3 worlds with the core gameplay mechanic. 

And the most exciting part is the online coop mode! You can now play the puzzle with your friends online on Steam by using the Remote Play Together feature! 


It's difficult time now to see your family and friends if you live separately, but not on Minimal Move anymore!

Please try this online coop mode! Stay home and stay safe but enjoy the time!

Don't hesitate to invite your family and friends to Minimal Move! Let's play together!


New contents will be added during the early access such as cinematics, skin system, and new puzzles.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/30f7151a8128194c92751a4fdc19a46467680620.jpg


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/ea6dd22d3190b2639506edd8d335752ae52a3068.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/11fe7ea51db43ee23c9fabbe3863685b0d86c096.jpg


We are so excited about this release and we are curious what people say about this game.


The production is still continuing.


Before you buy this early access version (if you are willing to do so... we hope!) , we have to mention that this is an early access version which means it's not finished yet completely.



We did this early access for making better game with people's feedback.



We need to know your opinion, both good and bad.



Please give us your feedback by our Steam community hub, on our Discord, DM us by Twitter, Instagram, and Facebook, or simply email us!


We hope you enjoy it! Thank you!

notes.title: Concept art of Minimal Move!
notes.content:
Minimal Move is a cooperative puzzle game in 3D! 
But here is our concept art in 2D! 

There will be 7 worlds for the main story of the game. 

The main characters, Kaiten and Ido as the space investigators, land in a wonder cubic world, where they attempt to discover the truth about the planet!  

Each world will have different types of blocks for new ways of playing the puzzle. You can gradually develop your skills step by step.

Today, we introduce you the first three worlds with the 2D art! 
You can already try these 3 worlds on Steam! Try the demo now! 

Which world is your favorite? Please leave your comment below and let us know!

And don't forget to add Minimal Move on your wishlist!

OASIS WORLD

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/d24ba0315e287cc3228059c366ac63a76e9176ee.png

This is the very first world when you enter Minimal Move! It’s relatively safe and simple but be careful of cactus. Kaiten and Ido have arrived in this world, now discover how to play with you and your friend! 

LAVA WORLD

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/89fcff7a37973b19dda98e9ffca40d2daf9aea06.png

It’s pretty hot here in Lava World! Watch out for your feet because the lava cube can burn you! The guard of this world, Flamin, will try to block your way. 

LUNAR WORLD 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/d7a1fabb7cb1cd23a02c9ff821f16f5a0338e2a3.png

The sky gets darker here in Lunar World... The jumper cube can transfer you to another jumper cube. Also, be careful because the robot Beaman is trying to heat up the blocks with his laser beam to catch you!

notes.title: Summer greetings from Tako Studio and new updates!
notes.content:
Happy Summer Greeting from Tako Studio!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/add4ae2219f3b04da21ec67dc9dffd3ab8f50a94.jpg

Are you enjoying the good summer breeze? It’s been a while since we wrote you our update. 

After our Kickstarter, we took a good break from the computer for a while and also we prepared for our next move! Now we are fully charged and ready to kick our new start for the rest of 2019! 

And now we have so many exciting news that we want to share with you! Here we go! 


We are going to Tokyo Game Show!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/3482f5a09afca533406862f5f0f3aacb69723632.jpg

This is the great news for us! 

We are happy to announce that we have been selected for the Selection Booth of the Indie Game Area at the Tokyo Game Show (TGS)! YES!!! 

This indie booth is free of charge and only selected indie games can be presented there! We are super honored to be one of them and so excited to be able to introduce Minimal Move in TGS! 

TGS is one of the biggest game events in the world! It will be the biggest game event ever for us! We are expected to see many people there! If you are planning to come, please let us know! Please stop by at our stand! We will let you know more information once we got it! 

And please don’t forget to follow our Twitter by then! We will tweet during our trip in Japan and TGS! Yuu who is doing the PR and communication for Tako Studio is originally from Tokyo, so she can share the deeper culture about Tokyo Game Show with you! Don’t miss it!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/127ba073899a518ccd4ab3bf7057f80efcaf2b92.jpg

Tokyo Game Show 

Place: Makuhari Messe 

DATE: September 12th-13th Business day, September 14th – 15th Public day

Check here for more information and ticket! 

https://expo.nikkeibp.co.jp/tgs/2019/en/


We are nominated in the Strasbourg Indie Game Award!


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/65295f85d6c1716f76fbbd3503630c49ec84f222.jpg

Another happy news! Yay! 

We are nominated as one of 12 finalists for the Indie Game Contest of the Strasbourg Festival of Fantastic Film! 

Unfortunately, we are not able to be there at this event, but Minimal Move will be displayed over there during this event, so if you are planning to go there, please stop by and try to play Minimal Move!  

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/b1736ec119865cba075a19d351c1be62bdec14cf.jpg

Strasbourg Festival of Fantastic Film

DATE: September 13th- 22th 

http://strasbourgfestival.com/



Our new office!!! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/72e16aa0215c252cabbc687f273ea8015b43f7c3.jpg

Do you know that we were making Minimal Move at our living room? 

But not anymore! 

We got our first office in Montreuil! Montreuil is just next to Paris. There are many start up companies and actually many game companies here! 

We are sharing one space in the co-working space. We can use the meeting rooms and relaxing space of this building. We are expecting to work here even better condition! 

If you have chance to stop by, let us know!   


Our new team is on board! 


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/8b35930cdd6efb46aad14bd065c1cdc0e3b8d31a.jpg

Let us introduce our new team Ambre! 

She will work with us for her internship for 6 months! She is working with us as a 2D / 3D artist! We are super excited to work with her! We are sure that she can help us a lot! 

She just finished her 3D art master school in Bordeaux, France, and actually she was Jonathan’s student in this school. 

She is an artist in the making who has a big potential. We will do our best to support her to open up her further potential! 

Please look forward to see her art! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/43c4bef47bcf4846d2f6b816b7771e49ceb1edb7.jpg
Team photo!

Add Minimal Move on your WISHLIST on Steam! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/399727f273681203b27976306f27501f20c6f066.jpg

Don’t forget to add Minimal Move on your wish-list on Steam! 

Please support us by doing this! 

Your one click will encourage us! Your kind action is always pushing us forward! 

Thank you so much! 


Follow us on our Twitter, Instagram, and FaceBook! 

We will update our news and newest images and videos on our SNS! 

Please follow us if you haven’t already! 

And don’t hesitate to leave us your comments! We are dying to know what you think! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/320af55b41d55d8cf8b65392c967f8aefed97e7e.jpg

Thank you for always supporting us! 

We wish you the best summer and talk to you soon!

notes.title: Introducing main character IDO of Minimal Move!
notes.content:
Minimal Move is a cooperative puzzle game in 3D.

The game starts when the two space investigators, Kaiten and Ido landed on a mysterious planet.

She is very calm and sophisticated independent woman.

The mission is to discover and to reveal the secret of this mysterious planet of Minimal Move.

The good teamwork is a key to success! Good luck!

notes.title: Introducing Lunar World!
notes.content:
Lunar World... A blue dimly lit world in the moonlight...

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/e2afca6e39de76fbc8c378b103fa428483e824ba.png

Let's introduce Minimal Move's third world, Lunar world!

It sounds pretty and romantic but it’s getting harder and harder!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/3c7188372fd1c5805eae7c890d8e2fa388d5f606.jpg

There is a fun cube to play with in this world which is called a Jumper cube!

The jumper cube can transfer Kaiten and Ido to the other jumber cube!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/886ff3ef253d616683fc97c4c5f84277acbdb4a4.jpg

A new robot in this world, Beaman is heating up blocks by his beam. He will stop you leaving from this world in silence... And yes, the beam can kill KAITEN and IDO... Watch out!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/8a5c6f23f59ad56c5194fe2a60e8eba73573cb6c.jpg

How to get out from this world!?? More and more challenging!!!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/346c9493b794b7cfd59f63e46f6bf73874b54b4b.jpg

notes.title: Introducing Lava World!
notes.content:
Lava World! It's hot in here!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/0b6b8680cacb13e18da6de82e437344b7b5f141e.png

Let's introduce Minimal Move's second world, Lava World!

Lava world is much more tricky than Oasis World!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/ee8f9e1b5fd7a0274bce5534f8e6b57a4ed5786f.jpg

Lava world is like it says, a hot world!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/886ff3ef253d616683fc97c4c5f84277acbdb4a4.jpg

The blocks are dangerous! They can burn them up!

You can move blocks using a Lava block. Watch your steps and use the heat to move blocks!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/2959b10e88a6b231d984132bc6baa32deddc7c0b.jpg

There is a new character Flammeche as a guard of this world.

He is cute, but he can make a block to a lava block so be careful!

notes.title: Introducing Oasis World!
notes.content:
Oasis World! What is that?

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/f70f4a3962fc340a2662e6c129045fd2368a6479.png

Let’s introduce Minimal Move's first world, Oasis World!

This will be the first world that you'll go.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/efb65e7908c5c533639c9c0eabd5dd2f3a43cd9f.jpg

It’s an introductory world so let’s say it’s pretty much safe.

There are some cactus that block your way.

You'll get used to how to use the controllers, the mechanics of this game, and the most importantly you'll get to know how to think in 3D!

We are so used to see things in 2D on the game, so first you might get confused to think in 3D because the blocks will turn all the way around!



Oasis World is pretty safe but it's a good exercise of your brain!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/45077fa50ea3e5a001687f9c1380f3ccb70543e6.jpg

In the beginning, you might think it’s difficult, but it’s actually getting simple later!

Next world will be much more dangerous! Be prepared for that!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/2e688459d7d5c1e5141ce1b49b4a6c2df4c03d14.jpg
